claims.claim: Research examining more than 1,700 administrations from 2019 found that 44 percent of pre-pack deals involving connected parties resulted in a second insolvency by July 2026.
claims.episode_span: Research examining more than 1,700 administrations from 2019 found that 44 percent of pre-pack deals involving connected parties resulted in a second insolvency by July 2026.
claims.source_title: Bust companies revived in ‘phoenix’ deals more likely to fail again, study finds
claims.supporting_quote: It found that 44% of pre-packs had resulted in a second insolvency by July 2026 when assets were bought by a connected party.

claims.claim: Between 100 and 200 U.S. soldiers were in Saudi Arabia as part of a new joint force command to facilitate AI-assisted targeting.
claims.episode_span: Deutsche Welle described U.S. assistance to Saudi Arabia through an AI-assisted targeting tool similar to the Maven Smart System, noting between 100 and 200 U.S. personnel on the ground.
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia looks to US for an AI edge as Yemen's Houthis up pressure
claims.supporting_quote: A September report by US broadcaster CNN, quoting several unnamed American officials, said that between 100 and 200 US soldiers were in Saudi Arabia as part of new joint force command to facilitate this.

claims.claim: The exhibition presents the detailed life stories of 100 of the most significant Roma partisans and Roma soldiers from the Czech underground army and resistance groups.
claims.episode_span: The display features detailed accounts of 100 fighters selected from the archives.
claims.source_title: Prague honours Roma resistance fighters against Hitler
claims.supporting_quote: We found over 1,400 Romani fighters in the archives. From among them, we selected the 100 most interesting stories for this exhibition.
